// diagnostic

E-WEB-TIR-UNSUPPORTED

Web output cannot compile `{fn}` yet.

What

Web output cannot compile `{fn}` yet.

Why

Web builds use the same checked executable body path as native builds; this function uses a construct the web output cannot lower today (D-WEBTIR1).

Fix

Move the unsupported work behind a Wasm export that uses covered Jet constructs, or simplify this function for the web target.

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E-WEB-TIR-UNSUPPORTED: tests/ui/web_tir_unsupported.stderr.

Error [E-WEB-TIR-UNSUPPORTED]: web output cannot compile `run` yet
